final: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM film_actor fa INNER JOIN film f ON fa.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt FROM rating_counts), kept_groups AS (SELECT rc.cnt FROM rating_counts rc CROSS JOIN avg_count ac WHERE rc.cnt > ac.avg_cnt) SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_count, AVG(cnt - (SELECT avg_cnt FROM avg_count)) as avg_deviation FROM kept_groups
